item.title: Graded on a Curve: Charanjit Singh, Synthesizing: Ten Ragas to a Disco Beat

item.title: TVD Radar: The Podcast with Dylan Hundley, Episode 201: Sergio Rotman
item.description: I recently spoke with Sergio Rotman, composer and saxophonist best known for his work with Los Fabulosos Cadillacs, the influential Argentine ska/rock band. With the Cadillacs he won the Grammy Award for Best Latin Rock/Alternative Performance for Fabulosos Calavera in 1998—the first time an Argentine band received a Grammy.
